title: 第24章 小白桦与金库

第24章 小白桦与金库-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

王建新从GUM百货商店出来，天还没亮透。他在街边的暗处站了一会儿，看了看四周，没人注意他。从空间里放出那辆嘎斯69，开着车在莫斯科的街头转悠，想找个地方先躲起来，观察一下情况。

莫斯科的早晨很冷，零下二十几度，街上的行人裹着厚厚的衣服，缩着脖子走路。路边的面包店已经开始营业了，飘出烤面包的香味。王建新开着车，慢慢地穿过几条街道。

拐过一个街角，他看见路边有一家商店。门脸不大，甚至可以说很低调，灰白色的墙面，没有醒目的招牌，只在门上方挂着一块小牌子。但门口站着两个警察，穿着灰色大衣，背着枪，笔直地站在门两边。一看就不一般。

王建新把车停在不远处，仔细看了看那块牌子。牌子上用俄文写着——“Берёзка”，小白桦。

“小白桦商店。”王建新念了一遍，心里一动。

他听说过这种商店。苏联的小白桦商店，专门服务外国人、外交官、高级官员和特权阶层，跟京城的友谊商店一个性质。里面的东西不是卢布能买的，要用外汇券或者硬通货。普通人别说进去了，连门都摸不着。

“自己也是老外嘛，可以去看看。”王建新笑了笑。

他把车开进一条小巷，趁没人注意，把车收入空间，然后快速来到商店附近。他绕到商店后面，躲在一个角落里观察了一会儿。商店的后院不大，有一扇铁门，锁着，墙上没有窗户。他用神识探了一下——里面没人，安全。

几个瞬移，刷刷刷几下，王建新就进了商店里面。炼气三层的空间挪移用得越来越熟练了，十米范围内无视任何障碍物，穿墙跟喝水一样简单。

商店里面不大，但也说不上小，大概两三百平米的样子。装修比外面的普通商店精致得多，地上铺着地毯，墙上挂着油画，不像商店，倒像是个私人会所。货架上摆着各种商品，但数量不多，走的是精品路线。

王建新站在入口处，环顾四周。

直接看到的是食品与酒区。各种鱼子酱——俄罗斯的、伊朗的，红鱼子酱、黑鱼子酱，装在精致的玻璃罐里。伏特加，不是外面卖的那种普通货，而是专供出口的高级货，瓶身设计精美，贴着金色的标签。马爹利干邑，一瓶一瓶地躺在木盒子里，看着就贵。

西方的烟酒糖果。万宝路、三五，一盒一盒的。瑞士莲巧克力，花花绿绿的包装。英国的水果糖，法国的太妃糖。进口的肉罐头——斯帕姆午餐肉、丹麦火腿、匈牙利萨拉米香肠。鲑鱼、鳟鱼，烟熏的、盐腌的，真空包装。各种奶酪，法国的布里、瑞士的埃门塔尔、意大利的帕尔玛，用蜡封着，摆在恒温柜里。

“全部收走。”王建新手一挥，货架和东西凭空消失。

旁边是服装与配饰区。鞋帽——意大利的皮鞋、奥地利的皮靴、英国的毡帽，一双双一双双地摆在架子上。意大利领带，丝绸的，花色繁多。英国呢绒，成匹的，深色的、格子的，厚实挺括。最让王建新意外的是——牛仔裤。

“这时候就有人穿牛仔裤了吗？”王建新拿起一条牛仔裤看了看。蓝色的，铜扣，跟后世的牛仔裤差不多。这个年代，牛仔裤在西方是年轻人的时尚，在苏联绝对是稀罕物，一般老百姓见都没见过。

全收走。

然后是化妆品与香水区。法国香水，香奈儿、迪奥、娇兰，一瓶一瓶地摆在玻璃柜里，瓶子精致得像艺术品。法国化妆品，粉底、口红、眼影，各种颜色各种款式。王建新不认识牌子，但看着就高档。

“全收走，给老娘和妹妹用，还有嫂子。”王建新把化妆品区的货架一扫而空。

接着是电子产品区。日本的录音机、收录机，索尼、松下，银色的面板，闪亮的旋钮。东芝电视机，彩色的，不大，但在这个年代绝对是奢侈品。音响设备，功放、音箱、唱片机，德国的、日本的，堆了一堆。德国的晶体管收音机。

“真是要啥有啥呀。”王建新把这些电子产品全部收入空间。

最后是文化产品区。各种艺术书籍，画册、雕塑集、建筑图册，精装的、铜版纸的，印刷精美。精美的套娃，一个套一个，最大的有半人高，最小的只有指甲盖大小，画工精细，色彩艳丽。还有各种各样的书籍杂志，俄语的、英语的、法语的，文学类、科技类、艺术类，堆满了书架。

“不管了，先收走，放在自己的书房，以后慢慢看。”

王建新在文化产品区的最里面发现了一摞汽车图册。不是普通的图册，而是商品目录——可以通过图册选购汽车，填写订单，然后去指定地点提车。他翻了翻，里面有各种车型，苏联的、东欧的、西欧的，应有尽有。图册的最后几页印着提车处的地址，应该是一个仓库。

“这个店这么低调，卖的东西可是很牛啊。”王建新把汽车图册收好，准备以后有机会去看看那个提车处。

When Wang Jianxin came out of GUM Department Store, it was still dark.He stood in the darkness on the street for a while and looked around. No one noticed him.He released the GAZ 69 from space and drove around the streets of Moscow, trying to find a place to hide and observe the situation.

It was very cold in the morning in Moscow, more than 20 degrees below zero. Pedestrians on the street were wrapped in thick clothes and walked with their necks curled up.The bakery on the roadside is already open for business, and the smell of baking bread wafts out.Wang Jianxin drove slowly through several streets.

Turning a corner, he saw a shop on the side of the road.The front door is not big, it can even be said to be very low-key, with gray and white walls, no eye-catching signboard, and only a small sign hanging above the door.But there were two policemen standing at the door, wearing gray coats and carrying guns, standing straight on both sides of the door.It's unusual at first glance.

Wang Jianxin parked his car not far away and looked at the sign carefully.The sign says in Russian - "Берёзка", small white birch.

"Little Baihua Store." Wang Jianxin read it again, and his heart moved.

He had heard of such stores.The Little White Birch Store in the Soviet Union specializes in serving foreigners, diplomats, senior officials and the privileged class, and has the same nature as the Friendship Store in the capital.The things inside cannot be bought with rubles, you need to use foreign exchange coupons or hard currency.Ordinary people can't even touch the door, let alone go in.

"I am a foreigner myself, so I can go and have a look." Wang Jianxin smiled.

He drove the car into an alley, put the car into the space when no one was looking, and then quickly came to the store.He went around to the back of the store and hid in a corner to observe for a while.The backyard of the store is not big. There is an iron gate, which is locked, and there are no windows on the wall.He used his spiritual sense to check it out - no one was inside, it was safe.

After a few teleports and a few clicks, Wang Jianxin entered the store.I have become more and more proficient in using the space movement on the third level of Qi Refining. Ignore any obstacles within ten meters, and walking through walls is as easy as drinking water.

The store isn't big inside, but it can't be said to be small, about two to three hundred square meters.The decoration is much more exquisite than the ordinary stores outside, with carpets on the floor and oil paintings on the walls. It doesn't look like a store, but more like a private club.There are various products on the shelves, but the quantity is not large, and they are high-quality products.

Wang Jianxin stood at the entrance and looked around.

Directly visible is the food and wine area.All kinds of caviar - Russian, Iranian, red caviar, black caviar, packed in exquisite glass jars.Vodka is not the ordinary product sold outside, but a high-end product specially designed for export. The bottle is beautifully designed and has a golden label.Martell Cognac, lying bottle by bottle in wooden boxes, looks expensive.

Western tobacco, alcohol and candies.Marlboro, Triple Five, boxes after boxes.Lindt chocolate, colorful packaging.British fruit candy, French toffee.Imported canned meat – Spam luncheon meat, Danish ham, Hungarian salami.Salmon, trout, smoked, salted, vacuum packed.Various cheeses, including French Brie, Swiss Emmental, and Italian Parma, are sealed with wax and placed in a thermostatic cabinet.

"Take them all away." Wang Jian waved his hand, and the shelves and things disappeared out of thin air.

Next to it is the clothing and accessories section.Shoes and hats - Italian leather shoes, Austrian leather boots, British felt hats, are placed on the shelves in pairs.Italian ties, silk, in many colors.British woolen cloth, in pieces, dark, plaid, thick and crisp.What surprised Wang Jianxin the most was jeans.

"Is anyone wearing jeans at this time?" Wang Jianxin picked up a pair of jeans and looked at them.Blue, with copper buttons, similar to jeans of later generations.In this era, jeans are a fashion among young people in the West, but they are definitely a rarity in the Soviet Union, and ordinary people have never seen them.

Take them all away.

Then there is the cosmetics and perfume section.French perfumes, Chanel, Dior, Guerlain, are displayed in glass cabinets bottle by bottle. The bottles are as exquisite as works of art.French cosmetics, foundation, lipstick, eye shadow, various colors and styles.Wang Jianxin didn't recognize the brand, but it looked high-end.

"Take them all away for my mother, sister, and sister-in-law." Wang Jianxin swept away the shelves in the cosmetics section.

Next is the electronic products area.Japanese recorders and cassette recorders, Sony and Panasonic, with silver panels and shiny knobs.Toshiba TV, color, is not big, but it is definitely a luxury product in this era.There are piles of audio equipment, including amplifiers, speakers, and record players, from Germany and Japan.German transistor radio.

"You can get whatever you want." Wang Jianxin put all these electronic products into the space.

Finally, there is the cultural products area.Various art books, picture albums, sculpture collections, architectural albums, hardcover, coated paper, beautifully printed.The exquisite matryoshka dolls are nested one inside another. The largest one is half a person's height and the smallest one is only the size of a fingernail. The paintings are exquisite and the colors are bright.There are also a variety of books and magazines, in Russian, English, French, literature, science and technology, and art, filling the bookshelves.

"No matter, take it away first and put it in your study. You can read it later."

Wang Jianxin found a stack of car albums at the end of the cultural products area.It's not an ordinary photo album, but a product catalog - you can choose a car through the photo album, fill in the order, and then go to the designated location to pick up the car.He flipped through it, and there were various models in it, including Soviet, Eastern European, and Western European models.The last few pages of the album printed the address of the place where the car was picked up, which should be a warehouse.

"This store is so low-key, but the things it sells are really good." Wang Jianxin put away the car brochure, preparing to visit the car pick-up area when he has the opportunity in the future.
